usage: A common noun for a metal blend; in everyday Cantonese, it often shows up in product descriptions, manufacturing, and material labels.
It is usually used before another noun to describe what something is made of, especially jewelry, tools, parts, and industrial materials.
This word sounds neutral and practical, not poetic or fancy; use it when talking about material composition rather than appearance.
Learners can treat it like an English noun that names a substance, so it often works well in set phrases about quality, hardness, durability, and cost.
